question.prompt: Use the school flagpole as the origin, due east as the positive x-direction, and due north as the positive y-direction, with 1 unit representing 10 m. The cafeteria has coordinates \((3,-4)\), and the dormitory has coordinates \((3,2)\). How many meters apart are they? (Unit: m.)

solutions.explanation: The two points have the same x-coordinate, so the segment joining them is parallel to the y-axis. The distance is \(|2-(-4)|=6\) units, or \(6\times10=60\text{ m}\).
solutions.title: Vertical separation and physical distance
